definitions.explanation: The number 50,000, formed as {五|ご} (five) × {万|まん} (10,000).

examples.japanese: {五万|ごまん}⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
⟦コンサート→コンサート：01360_konsaato⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{五万|ごまん}⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: Fifty thousand people gathered for the concert.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{五万|ごまん}⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧ほどだ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われた→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{実際|じっさい}→実際：02502_jissai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦もっと→もっと：00798_motto⟧⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: I was told the moving costs would be about fifty thousand yen, but it actually came to more.

notes:
Formed as ⟦{五|ご}→五：00697_go⟧ × ⟦{万|まん}→万：00795_man⟧, with no sound change.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {五万|ごまん}⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧: fifty thousand yen
- {五万|ごまん}⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧: fifty thousand people
- {五万|ごまん}⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧: fifty thousand copies
ごまんと⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ means "there are heaps of them" — an idiomatic exaggeration rather than a real count, and it is written in kana. ⟦そんな→そんな：01645_sonna⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ごまんと⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ "stories like that are a dime a dozen".
